artworks.title: Pride
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper with liftable flap
artworks.description: The engraving shows a woman standing in an upright posture facing the viewer. She has detailed facial features and styled hair with a hairpiece. She wears an elaborate gown with patterns, lace, and accessories. She holds a branch in her right hand and rests her left hand on a peacock. The background features architectural motifs, sculptural figures, and circular emblems with classical scenes. Latin text accents the image.

artworks.title: Fiero monstruo! (Fierce Monster!)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on Arches laid paper [trial proof printed posthumously in the Calcografia in 1957-58]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large animal devouring a smaller one. The image shows a realistic and anatomical portrayal of a larger animal with detailed fur texture and muscular definition consuming a smaller animal. The drawing is executed in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the dark and foreboding nature of the scene. The detail in the fur and the pose captures a sense of motion and raw power, while the textured backdrop contrasts with the vivid lines of the animal figures. The etching also carries the number '81' in the upper left corner and is marked '96/110' in the lower right.

artworks.title: Esto es lo verdadero (This Is the Truth)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, burin and burnisher on Arches laid paper [trial proof printed posthumously in the Calcografia in 1957-58]
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white etching showing two people and a goat. The male figure on the left holds an implement, possibly a spade, with his right hand. He is clothed in a tattered garment and rustic footwear. The female figure on the right has her head turned towards the man. She is wearing a long dress or robe with bell sleeves. Beside them is a basket filled with fruit, near a goat that is eating from it. The background features heavy foliage with dense trees and branches.

artworks.title: The Landing of the Dutch Expedition Party in New York
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing with a soft, monochromatic color palette mainly in brown tones. The drawing shows fluid lines and brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement and depth. An ornate border surrounds the scene, resembling branches or waves with decorative elements, including an owl-like creature. In the foreground, a man stands near a tree aiming upward, while another person kneels. In the background, three men in historical attire face a group of individuals. Further back, a tent-like structure and a sailing ship are visible on the horizon. The composition features a high horizon, providing a broad view of the scene.

artworks.title: The Chief of the Mamelukes on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows two men, one on a horse and the other standing beside it. The man on the horse is in an elevated position, with a resolute facial expression, a beard, sharp eyebrows, a turban, a robe with ornate patterns, and sheathed knives in his waistband. The man standing beside the horse is shirtless with a muscular build, hair styled into two puffs, holding the horse's bridle in one hand and a stick or staff in the other. The setting behind them is sparsely depicted, with suggestive lines possibly indicating a landscape or horizon.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a view overlooking a pastoral scene with a river to the left, a field to the right, and a stone bridge in the distance. Near the edge of the field, there is a wooden cart with a green cover and a person resting under its shade. The river flows towards the stone bridge. In the background are some small structures on the bridge and leafy trees. The painting has a soft color palette predominantly of greens, blues, and earthy browns, and features delicate brushstrokes in an impressionistic style.

artworks.title: The White House
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic portrait of the White House. The building is depicted in a frontal view from a street-level perspective. The roofline defines the horizon, with an American flag flying at the top. The style features detailed brushstrokes creating texture and depth, particularly in the shadows and architectural elements. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black and white, accentuating the contrast between light and dark. Pedestrians are shown walking on the street in front of a wrought-iron fence, adding scale and a sense of everyday life. Trees surround the building, providing a natural backdrop to the structure.

artworks.title: View near Jessup's Landing
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William Guy Wall
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding path leading into a wooded area. A large tree with green foliage stands nearby, with branches reaching towards the sky. In the background, there are hills and tree-covered slopes. The sky is blue with yellow tones near the horizon. The painting skillfully captures the textures of the natural elements and the afternoon light filtering through the setting. The color palette includes greens, earth tones, blues, and yellows. A river is visible, reflecting the sky's colors.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaging with one central figure. The image depicts several figures with expressions of awe, surprise, and reverence. They are dressed in long robes. The central figure is distinguished by a halo-like decoration around the head. The gathering is set in a simple background with minimalistic details like sparse foliage.

artworks.title: Der Groff (The Count)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person in an elaborate outfit being confronted by a skeletal figure. The drawing depicts a scene where an ornately dressed figure is in the foreground. They are adorned with detailed garments featuring textures such as pleats and an elaborate cloak, and a wide-brimmed hat lies on the ground nearby. Behind them stands a skeletal figure wielding a scythe. The background shows a landscape of hills and skies.

artworks.title: Der Künig (The King)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts a king sitting at a table with skeletons attending to him. The scene is ornately designed, with a figure seated in a throne-like chair at the head of a table, surrounded by attendants. On one side, there is a figure carving an object placed on the table, while on the other side, skeletal figures are serving the table. The background includes a tapestry with decorative motifs. The architectural setting features columns and a detailed interior space, suggesting an opulent setting.

artworks.title: Der Ritter (The Knight)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white print of an armored knight fighting a skeleton. The knight is in full armor, holding a sword. He is contorted to the side to avoid a blow from the skeleton's lance. The skeleton wears an armored breastplate with chainmail sleeves which hang loosely off of its bones, and it thrusts a long lance towards the knight. The scene is set in a landscape with an open field scattered with stones under a sky with dark clouds. The sun appears to set below the low horizon. At the very bottom of the print, an hourglass lies on its side. The print is inside a think black rectangular outline, and above the top are the words "Der Ritter."

artworks.title: Die Edelfrau (The Noblewoman)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger

artworks.title: Der Artzet (The Physician)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a skeletal figure interacting with seated figures in a medieval setting. The skeletal figure holds an hourglass. Nearby, another figure stands with a cane. The setting features shelves with books and alchemical tools, with a small animal on the floor. The scene is framed by a decorative archway with intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Peasant Brawl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.1 x 32.7 cm (8 11/16 x 12 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in an action scene. The image depicts several figures tangled in what appears to be a chaotic struggle near a rustic wooden fence. The figures are dressed in heavy, loose-fitting garments, heavily shaded and crafted with cross-hatching to indicate folds and depth. The background of the drawing features detailed textures of trees and a brick structure. The drawing's use of dynamic lines and detailed etching draws attention to the intense movement and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Rustic Wedding Dance
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Jan Brueghel the Elder, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a 16th-century village festival with detailed human activity and natural elements. Various groupings of people engage in activities such as dancing, conversation, and music-making. Figures dance energetically on a grassy area leading to trees. A group sits together under a canopy, possibly partaking in food or drink. The scene extends to the right, showing a road, people, structures, and a hillside in the distance. In the background, a church spire rises above the trees. The image features intricate textures and patterns in a monochromatic scheme, focusing on light and dark interplay with line intricacy.

artworks.title: Voltaire
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an elderly man seated from the waist up. He has deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a long nose. His face has wrinkles, and he wears a cap with some hair peeking out. He is dressed in a voluminous outer garment covering his shoulders and arms. The drawing is done in a simple line style with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the image is bordered with a double line. There is text written beneath the illustration.

artworks.title: Terrace of St. Cloud (Terrasse de St. Cloud)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with people gathered under a tree on the left side, with dogs playing nearby. In the distance is a river or lake with a bridge crossing it. The colors are muted with fine, detailed brushstrokes. The sky has subtle horizontal patterns.

artworks.title: Falls of Niagara
artworks.artist: Charles Hunt after James Pattison Cockburn
artworks.medium: aquatint with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall scene, likely Niagara Falls, from an elevated viewpoint on Goat Island. People are gathered on grass near trees, with picnic items on a cloth nearby. The sky meets distant land on the horizon, partially obscured by clouds. The falls are on the right, with water falling into mist, with a faint rainbow. The brushwork is detailed, capturing textures in foliage and water realistically. The color palette includes greens, browns, blues, and grays, enhancing the waterfall's presence.

artworks.title: Mona Lisa Bela
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view portrait of a woman, focusing on her bust area. She is positioned facing left within the frame. Her facial features include a sharp nose, a slightly smiling mouth, and curved eyebrows. Her hair is covered by an intricately patterned headdress that extends upward and backward. The headdress is detailed with floral motifs and patterns. She is wearing clothing with elaborate patterns similar to the headdress. No jewelry or objects are visible on her. The background appears plain, allowing the decorated border to stand out significantly. The border surrounding her consists of symmetrical floral and geometric motifs and contains the text "MONA LISA BELA."

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows a circular shape filled with intricate patterns and lines forming an abstract composition. The center features converging curved and flowing lines that suggest a gathering of human figures. In the upper part, the lines outline figures resembling angels with wings. Decorative borders with swirling motifs similar to floral and vine patterns enhance the intricate design.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and foliage within an ornamental oval frame. The central imagery shows two main figures and an additional figure above them amidst swirling clouds. The foreground features patterns of vines, flowers, and decorative motifs. At the bottom of the oval, there is a decorative border with a winged face.

artworks.title: The Capture of Troy
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various figures and ornamental designs. The image depicts a group of figures in an elaborate setting, surrounded by swirling patterns and decorative elements. The central figures appear to be in a dynamic interaction, with some standing and others kneeling. The background is filled with ornate, floral-like patterns. The lower part of the image presents additional figures and decorative details.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts Jesus in the center of the cross, with two others on either side. Below them are figures in robes with expressions of grief and reverence, while Roman soldiers rest in the foreground. The border of the image is ornately decorated with floral patterns and accents. The scene features shading, intricate line work, and textured details.
